finished_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. Scene: Golden field edge with a gently curving pale beige footpath along right, foreground grouped mustard and amber short harvest strokes, middle distance broad calm ochre field masses, pale lavender low hills. Bright midday atmosphere. Palette: 31 mustard yellow; 24 amber orange ochre; 95 ochre brown; 75 pale lavender; 82 deeper purple; 25 very pale gray-beige; 58 muted teal. Keep relative hue character, these are planning labels not calibrated exact colors.
